title: intent init does not keep the store out of git
body:
`intent init` writes no `.gitignore` rule for `intent/.cache/`, so `git add .` stages `intent.db`, which D34 says never enters history. (vc)

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): `intent init` calls the same `converge_gitignore` the migration calls, after it converges the formatter exclusion. A fresh project therefore ignores `intent/.cache/`, `intent/events.jsonl` and `intent/.backup/` by path, and never `*.db`, from its first commit.

Judged (scratchpad batch/judge-0323.txt, and the batch's full run):
- the new `init_keeps_the_store_out_of_git.rs` asserts the three rules, and then asks git itself: `git check-ignore intent/.cache/intent.db` succeeds;
- red with init's call removed (batch/judge-batch2-base-red.txt).
